description: This file contains unit tests for the data asset management system, specifically testing copy semantics and lineage behavior via HTTP API endpoints. It verifies that copying assets creates new records with distinct IDs, ensures lineage data is correctly stored and queryable, and enforces filter requirements on lineage queries.

classes.name: DbBackedCopyAndLineageTests
classes.description: Test class for verifying asset copy and lineage API behaviors in the DataAssetBackend project.

methods.name: Copy_asset_creates_new_asset_id_and_does_not_mutate_source
methods.description: Verifies that copying an asset results in a new asset record with a unique ID and that the source asset remains unchanged.

methods.name: Copy_creates_lineage_and_query_by_copy_operation_id_returns_result
methods.description: Checks that lineage data is created upon copying an asset and can be queried using the copy operation ID.

methods.name: Lineage_query_without_any_filters_returns_400
methods.description: Ensures that lineage queries without any filter parameters return a 400 Bad Request response.
